facts.value: Allows UL teaching staff to teach at a partner university abroad. Can be in any subject area/academic discipline. Minimum of 8 hours teaching must be respected. Staff Mobility Teaching Agreement can be found [here](/media/erasmus-and-icm-staff-mobility-for-teaching-agreement/download?inline).

metadata.chunk_title: Eligible Programme Countries + Types of Staff Mobility + Staff Mobility for Teaching + Staff Mobility for Training + Staff Mobility for Teaching and Training

facts.value: Allows UL teaching and non-teaching staff to undertake job shadowing/observation or attend training events (excluding conferences) at a partner university or at another relevant organisation abroad. A period abroad can combine teaching and training activities. Staff Mobility Training Agreement can be found [here](/media/erasmus-and-icm-staff-mobility-for-training-agreement/download?inline).

metadata.chunk_title: Eligible Programme Countries + Types of Staff Mobility + Staff Mobility for Teaching + Staff Mobility for Training + Staff Mobility for Teaching and Training

facts.value: Staff members can complete a combination of teaching and training activities as part of their mobility. Minimum of 4 hours teaching must be respected. Staff members combining teaching and training activities should complete the Staff Mobility Teaching Agreement [here](/media/erasmus-and-icm-staff-mobility-for-teaching-agreement/download?inline).

facts.value: staff.mobility@ul.ie
Funding is allocated on a first come basis.
5 working days excluding travel time

Identify the organisation you will visit and obtain permission from the organisation as well as your line manager. Discuss the type of activities you wish to undertake and create a programme of activities in collaboration with the host organisation.
Complete the Staff Mobility agreement for Teaching or Training. Answer all questions in full and include a detailed programme of activities.

The partner institution will sign your agreement, your line manager signs off on the quality of the agreement and grants permission to travel. Please do this at least 5 weeks prior to your intended travel date.
Submit your fully signed mobility agreement to staff.mobility@ul.ie and UL Global will sign the agreement regarding the administrative requirements.
Allow 10 working days for your contract to be issued.
80% of your grant payment will be made within 30 calendar days after the signature of the agreement by both parties.

Keep your boarding cards and submit copies of these along with a signed and stamped Certificate of Attendance from your host to staff.mobility@ul.ie within 10 days of your return from teaching/training.
Complete the final report which you will receive via email from a Europa.eu email address.
Your final grant payment will be made within 10 working days on receipt of all documentation.
Once your final grant payment is made, you must complete the Acknowledgement of Grant Receipt form and return the completed form to staff.mobility@ul.ie.
